legalBasis.rule: Paris Agreement Article 16 establishes Conference of Parties serving as meeting of Parties to Paris Agreement (CMA); Convention parties not Paris parties participate as observers in CMA proceedings; CMA decisions taken only by Paris Parties.
UNFCCC Article 7 establishes Convention COP and membership/representation of Convention Parties.

bodyStatuses.fullName: Conference of the Parties serving as meeting of the Parties to the Paris Agreement
bodyStatuses.decisionRight: not a Paris Party; cannot take CMA decisions as a Party

bodyStatuses.fullName: Conference of the Parties to the UNFCCC
bodyStatuses.decisionRight: retains Convention Party rights while UNFCCC membership effective

limitations: Formal Party decision rights do not establish the number of actual roll-call votes; climate COP processes frequently seek consensus.
COP and CMA can meet at the same venue but have different legal membership and decision authority.
No attendance records, roll-call actions, or quantified influence score inferred.
This closes the legal-body status subquestion only; full Gap 04 still requires other institutions.
